result:
Implemented `GET /export`:

- **`app/routes_export.py`**: new router with HTTP Basic auth. Credentials are validated only by calling `app.auth.login` (no password logic reimplemented); since another agent added mandatory OTP to `login`, I wired in `app.auth.otp_header` to read the `X-OTP` header, matching that new contract. `AuthError` → `401`.
- CSV columns come from `list(Reserva.model_fields)` and rows from `db.listar_reservas()`, built with the stdlib `csv` module — so it stays in sync automatically even after another agent renamed `fecha` → `inicio` in the model.
- Registered the router in `app/main.py`.
- Added `tests/test_export.py` (4 tests: valid creds, no creds, wrong password, empty DB), reusing the shared `otp_for` helper from `conftest.py` and asserting the header against `Reserva.model_fields` rather than hardcoded names.

All 29 tests pass (`uv run pytest`).
